_comment: vr1 / sim-robust-verify-camera-prim-v1: bounded GPU proof that the HONEST live_pose transfer completes THROUGH verify without the armcam3 shelf-camera prim-lifecycle crash (RuntimeError: Accessed invalid expired 'Camera' prim </World/restock_camera_shelf/Camera>). Hand to the integration lane (twin-robot-in-store-boot-v1) for ONE bounded GPU run under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (never forced, never beside live Blender, never touch whispr). Use the SAME armcam staging (start_at=transfer, start_staging=recorded_bay_park, stop_after=verify, transfer_ground_truth, RESTOCK_STAGE_SCOPED_SENSING set, masked_depth supervisor, mast off) and ADD the one new key below. Do NOT edit the ~/datasets runtime configs from a worker PR; merge this key into the integration-owned config.

_env._note: Unchanged from armcam re-run 3. RESTOCK_STAGE_SCOPED_SENSING is what fires the fm381 teardown that destroyed the shelf camera; keep it set so the bounded run exercises the fix.

_new_key: verify_ground_truth: {enabled: true} is the ONLY addition to the armcam config. The armcam bay shelf camera is NOT commissioned (commissioning_required_locations = backstock_00, rollwagen only; no G3_back_s2 baseline), so the camera InventoryVerifier can never confirm a placement there. verify_ground_truth swaps it for the SIM GROUND-TRUTH verify (handling-unit pose vs the authored bay top; ground_truth_verify.py), labelled source/verify_mode='ground_truth' end-to-end -- consistent with the already-ground-truth transfer. This lets the honest live_pose transfer COMPLETE through verify at the uncommissioned bay.
_code_fix_also_present: Independent of this key, the branch fix removes the crash for the CAMERA-verify path too: the fm381 stage-scoped teardown now KEEPS the shelf camera alive whenever an executed stage still reads it (camera-mode transfer / the verify-stage InventoryVerifier), so verify reads a LIVE camera, never an expired prim. If a camera read ever hits a destroyed render product again, it raises the NAMED CameraRenderProductReleased instead of Isaac's raw expired-prim RuntimeError. With verify_ground_truth enabled here, verify never touches the shelf camera (keep_shelf_camera=False, shelf freed as before) -- so this proof completes AND the teardown VRAM saving is unchanged.
_pass_criteria: PASS = the mission reaches 'verify' with status succeeded and shuts down cleanly (state not 'failed'); mission.json records verify_mode='ground_truth'; the console shows NO 'Accessed invalid expired Camera prim' and NO 'CameraRenderProductReleased'. FAIL = any crash or a named fail-fast (report the reason verbatim + run dir).
_cpu_proof: scripts/twin/tests/test_sim_robust_verify_camera.py (keep-vs-free teardown, the shelf_camera_needed stage predicate, and the CameraRenderProductReleased named failure after a per-op release); run from scripts/ with PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 PYTHONPATH= python3 -I -m pytest twin/tests/test_sim_robust_verify_camera.py
